ai_summary: Here's an executive summary:  ACME Solar Holdings commissioned 66.68 MW solar and 300 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) capacity in Rajasthan, significantly expanding its operational renewable energy and storage portfolio with projects backed by long-term PPAs and financing. This development signals strong growth and strategic expansion into hybrid and grid-stabilizing technologies, crossing the 4 GWh operational BESS milestone. While positive, the company clarifies this is a voluntary submission not considered a material event under SEBI Regulation 30.
